scripts.pack: npm run compile:runtime && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac dir --publish never
scripts.dist: npm run compile:runtime && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac dir,dmg --publish never
